topics.title: Macroalgae Hatchery & Sporophyte Seeding
topics.objective: Propagate juvenile Saccharina latissima (sugar kelp) gametophytes onto biodegradable grow ropes under controlled nursery conditions.
topics.exercise: Formulate a 40-day hatchery seeding protocol maintaining optimal nutrient broth and irradiance before ocean outplanting.

topics.title: Subsurface Longline Mooring & Hydrodynamic Load Modeling
topics.objective: Design submerged catenary anchor systems and tensioned header lines capable of surviving 5-meter storm wave actions.
topics.exercise: Calculate anchor ballast and buoy flotation requirements for a 200-meter longline farm deployed in 25-meter water depths.

topics.title: Nutrient Flux (Nitrogen/Phosphorus) & Biomass Growth Modeling
topics.objective: Monitor oceanic nitrate absorption, water temperature, and sunlight penetration to predict wet biomass yield per meter.
topics.exercise: Develop an in-situ sensor telemetry dashboard tracking seasonal ambient nitrate drawdown across the farm perimeter.

topics.title: Spring Harvesting Logistics & Cold-Chain Dewatering
topics.objective: Coordinate vessel-based harvest cutting, blanching, mechanical dewatering, and preservation for hydrocolloid and food processing.
topics.exercise: Create a vessel turnaround schedule preserving bio-active fucoidan and alginate compounds within 6 hours of harvest cutting.

topics.title: Deep-Ocean Carbon Sinking & Bioremediation Verification
topics.objective: Quantify fast-sinking particulate organic carbon (POC) transported below the permanent pycnocline for durable sequestration.
topics.exercise: Model sediment core carbon isotopes (delta-13C) to verify refractory kelp carbon burial over multi-decadal timescales.
